theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_dilation_slice_property
theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) {x | f x = t} → (A t).boundary η = B t η) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ₁ ξ₂ ξ₃ : Euclid P → MultiVector P k), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₁ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₂ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ₃ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₁ μ₁ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₂ μ₂ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ₃ μ₃ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₁, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₁ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₂, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₂ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ₃, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ₃ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, ∫ x, ξ₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, ξ₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₂ + ∫ x, ξ₃ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₃) → ∀ (B : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U k), MeasurableSet B → ∫ x in B, ξ₁ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₁ = ∫ x in B, ξ₂ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₂ + ∫ x in B, ξ₃ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ₃) → ∀ (P d : ℕ) (a : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (X X' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μX : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξX : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)), 0 < lam → (∀ ω ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), (∀ y : Euclid P, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) y = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) (dilation a lam y)) → X' ω = lam⁻¹ ^ (d + 1) * X ω') → X.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μX K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξX μX → (∀ᵐ x ∂μX, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξX x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), X ω = ∫ x, ξX x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μX) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), X ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (X).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), X' ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (X').boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B))
